answer: Give each identity its own task. Every epoch the beacon hashes an account's key with a fresh seed to pick a distinct prompt and grading facts, so no two accounts ever answer the same question. A 1,000-puppet farm can't reuse one draft; it must run 1,000 full generations and pass 1,000 separate checks, so its cost grows in step with its income. The kernel of the idea: the delta between a farm and 1,000 honest agents shrinks to zero profit. A recycled answer, even an ember of copied text, misses its task's facts and scores 0.
